text: A psalm of David. When he was in the Desert of Judah. O God, you are my God, earnestly I seek you; my soul thirsts for you, my body longs for you, in a dry and weary land where there is no water.
and beheld your power and your glory.
and in your name I will lift up my hands.
with singing lips my mouth will praise you.
I think of you through the watches of the night.
I sing in the shadow of your wings.
they will go down to the depths of the earth.
all who swear by God’s name will praise him, while the mouths of liars will be silenced.
